description: Reviewed direct LLM generation call sites (ADR-0188 D27). Checked by scripts/gates/check-llm-ledger-boundary.mjs. Reasons are a fixed vocabulary (REASONS in the script); `unwrapped` rows are WP-H4 follow-ups. The list may only shrink.

cli/src/eval/replay/recording-proxy.ts.note: `cognia eval record --live` pass-through proxy: forwards real /v1/messages requests to the provider, unledgered (eval tooling only).

cli/src/eval/replay/tape-server.ts.note: Loopback replay server that answers /v1/messages from recorded tapes (ADR-0118); it never calls a provider.

cli/src/x/proxy-server.ts.note: `cognia x` Tier-1 fallback proxy used when the Rust gateway is not running: forwards /v1/messages, /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses upstream with no passthrough ledger.

components/settings/network/tabs/test-ta.note: Default URL of the network proxy reachability test; the Rust `proxy_test` command sends a GET, never a generation request.

components/settings/settings-nav-config..note: Settings search keywords for the gateway page.

hooks/canvas/use-canvas-suggestions.ts.note: Canvas AI suggestions: generateObject on the configured or custom canvas provider, never reserved or settled.

lib/ai/agent/agent-executor.ts.note: executeAgent text channel (web/mobile, or no tools requested): one streamText completion with no ledger; its sidecar channel sends carry no ledger stamp either.

lib/ai/chat/standalone-engine.ts.note: Standalone (BYOK web/mobile) chat engine: streamText in the webview with same-provider finish-reason retries; ignores SendOptions.ledger, and the chat stamp is Tauri-only, so no surface ledgers it.

lib/ai/eval/targets/model.ts.note: Eval pure-model target: one generateText per case, no ledger.

lib/ai/generation/canvas-actions.ts.note: Canvas AI actions (canvas UI and the plugin API): generateText/streamText, no ledger.

lib/ai/operations/handlers/ai-sdk-surfac.note: AI operations executor throat (ADR-0163): text, object and stream operations call the AI SDK directly, no ledger.

lib/ai/operations/handlers/batches.ts.note: batches.create submits real Anthropic/OpenAI/Mistral/Gemini batch generation jobs; nothing is reserved or settled through the ledger.

lib/ai/providers/bedrock-connection.ts.note: Bedrock connection test: one generateText probe, no ledger.

lib/ai/renderer-llm-client.ts.note: buildRendererLlmClient wraps every client with ledgerUtilityCalls (utilityLedger by default): titles, timeline labels, the /goal judge, utility and agent-role clients, AI commit messages, the room primary router.

lib/ai/vision/caption.ts.note: Vision caption for multimodal embeddings: a generateText call (D27 applies even though it feeds an embedder), no ledger.

lib/plugin/runtime/renderer-host-runtime.note: Ambient plugin host runtime (renderer, desktop, mobile): plugin model calls stream through streamText with no ledger.

lib/plugin/vscode-shim/lm-handler.ts.note: VS Code `vscode.lm` shim: sendChatRequest runs generateText, no ledger.

lib/provider-diagnostics/benchmark.ts.note: User-run provider benchmark (PONG prompt): streamText, no ledger.

lib/router-fusion/calls/role-call-execut.note: Router + Fusion role calls: durable-call prepares each attempt and marks it DISPATCHED before this executor sends it, with maxRetries: 0.

lib/router-fusion/routing/llm-classifier.note: LLM route classifier (WP-E1, in flight): wraps its client with ledgeredLlmClient and beginLedgeredUtilityCall, one session-less utility run per classification, maxRetries: 0.

lib/subscription/anthropic/usage-probe.t.note: Opt-in Claude rate-limit probe: a paid, near-empty /v1/messages request, no ledger.

lib/twin/distill/index.ts.note: Barrel re-export of the raw client factory (listed in LLM_CLIENT_MODULES so its consumers are tracked); it calls nothing.

lib/twin/distill/llm.ts.note: createLlmClient / createAnthropicLlmClient: the raw LlmClient whose complete/stream call generateText/streamText. Ledgered only where a consumer wraps it; every consumer has its own row.

lib/twin/runtime/build-deps.ts.note: Twin LLM reranker: createLlmClient on the twin's own LLM config, never wrapped with ledgerUtilityCalls.

lib/twin/worker-runtime.ts.note: Twin distillation worker: createAnthropicLlmClient on the twin's own LLM config, never wrapped with ledgerUtilityCalls.

lib/wiki/rebuild-runner.ts.note: Wiki rebuild: createLlmClient from the active provider row, never wrapped with ledgerUtilityCalls.

lib/workflow/nodes/ai/ai-prompt-routed.t.note: ai.prompt v2 routed mode: makeClient = createLlmClient per routing candidate, unwrapped; fallback attempts are unledgered too.

lib/workflow/nodes/ai/ai-prompt-v2.ts.note: ai.prompt v2 explicit mode: createLlmClient, unwrapped (only the v1 executor in executors.ts is ledgered on agentsWorkflows).

lib/workflow/nodes/ai/executors.ts.note: ai.prompt v1 wraps createLlmClient with ledgerUtilityCalls on agentsWorkflows (ai.classify and ai.extract delegate to it); v2 lives in ai-prompt-v2.ts.

packages/ocr/src/providers/anthropic-vis.note: Cloud OCR through Claude vision on /v1/messages.

packages/ocr/src/providers/openai-vision.note: Cloud OCR through OpenAI vision on /v1/chat/completions.

packages/provider-core/src/providers/api.note: API-key login validation: a 1-token /chat/completions POST, no ledger.
Custom-provider connection test: the Anthropic protocol probe is a 1-token /v1/messages POST (the others GET /models), no ledger.

packages/provider-core/src/providers/loc.note: stopModel posts /api/generate with keep_alive: 0 and no prompt, which unloads an Ollama model; nothing is generated.

packages/provider-core/src/providers/oll.note: stopOllamaModel posts /api/generate with keep_alive: 0 and no prompt, which unloads the model; nothing is generated.

packages/provider-embedding/src/chunking.note: Semantic chunking's split-point call. It takes the host's `generate` seam, threaded from `ChunkingOptions.generate` and `RAGPipelineConfig.generate` (its only caller); the app's ingest paths call the synchronous `chunkDocument`, which never calls a model.

packages/rag/src/answer-grounding.ts.note: Self-reflective RAG grounding judge. The call takes the host's `generate` seam (WP-L2); no app path reaches it today — nothing builds a RAGPipeline and the app's grounding is heuristic — and a host that runs it takes the seam from `lib/ai/ledgered-generation-seam.ts`.

packages/rag/src/contextual-retrieval.ts.note: Contextual retrieval's per-chunk context and document summary. Both take the host's `generate` seam, threaded from `RAGPipelineConfig.generate` (their only caller); no app code builds a pipeline yet, and a host that does takes the seam from `lib/ai/ledgered-generation-seam.ts`.

packages/rag/src/query-expansion.ts.note: Query expansion, HyDE and step-back. Every stage takes the host's `generate` seam (WP-L2) and the project-knowledge path passes the ledgered one (`lib/project-knowledge/runtime/retrieve.ts` via `lib/ai/ledgered-generation-seam.ts`); the twin path (`lib/twin/runtime/apply-twin-context.ts`) still calls it unledgered and is WP-L1's call site.

packages/rag/src/rag-evaluator.ts.note: RAG quality metrics with an LLM judge. The judge call takes the host's `generate` seam (WP-L2); no app path reaches it today, and a host that runs it takes the seam from `lib/ai/ledgered-generation-seam.ts`.

packages/rag/src/reranker.ts.note: LLM cross-encoder rerank. `rerankWithLLM`/`rerank` take the host's `generate` seam, threaded from `RAGPipelineConfig.generate` (their only caller); the app's own reranker is `lib/twin/runtime/reranker.ts`. The Cohere rerank API path is outside D27.

packages/rag/src/retrieval-grader.ts.note: Corrective-RAG grading. `gradeDocumentLLM`/`gradeRetrievedDocuments` take the host's `generate` seam, threaded from `RAGPipelineConfig.generate`; the app's two graders (`lib/ai/retrieval/corrective-filter.ts`, `lib/external-bridge/handlers/rag.ts`) pass `useLLM: false` and call no model.

packages/router-fusion/src/api/chat-comp.note: CHAT_COMPAT_ENDPOINT names the endpoint the gateway serves for cognia/* models; no outbound call.

packages/tts/src/providers/gemini.ts.note: Gemini TTS through :generateContent with an audio response modality.

packages/tts/src/providers/xiaomi.ts.note: Xiaomi MiMo TTS served on an OpenAI-shaped /v1/chat/completions endpoint.

packages/web-search/src/providers/google.note: Gemini grounded web search: one `:generateContent` generation per search, which takes the host's `generate` seam; every app search reaches it through `lib/search/configured-search-core.ts`, which passes the ledgered seam from `lib/ai/ledgered-generation-seam.ts`. `testGoogleAIConnection` takes no seam on purpose: it is the user-initiated key probe D27 exempts.

packages/web-search/src/standalone-answe.note: Standalone (BYOK) cited web answer. The synthesis takes the host's `resolveGenerate` seam; the app binding `lib/search/standalone-answer.ts` returns the ledgered seam from `lib/ai/ledgered-generation-seam.ts`, bound to the provider it resolved.

sidecar/dispatch/anthropic.mjs.note: Agent SDK turns: an envelope ledger stamp engages createCallLedgerGate (tracked attempts, PreToolUse budget hooks, CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0, no fallbackModel). A send without the stamp (anything but a routed Tauri chat turn) runs unledgered.

sidecar/dispatch/feature-call.mjs.note: Sidecar feature calls for providers the renderer cannot execute (Bedrock, plugin protocols): model.doGenerate/doStream and adapter streams, with no ledger stamp on this path.

sidecar/dispatch/hook-native-executor.mj.note: Native prompt/agent hooks: an Agent SDK query under the hook's own $0.25 budget governor, not the CallLedger.

sidecar/dispatch/live-harness.mjs.note: Helper for the *.live.test.mjs suites: an in-process mock of the Anthropic Messages API; it never reaches a provider.

sidecar/dispatch/prewarm.mjs.note: startup() spawns and initializes a Claude Code subprocess with no prompt; the model call is the query anthropic.mjs sends on the claimed warm process.

sidecar/dispatch/protocol-adapters/ai-sd.note: streamText for every sidecar AI SDK leg; for a stamped send ai-sdk.mjs reserves each leg (and compaction/optical summaries) through call-ledger-gate and passes maxRetries: 0. Unstamped sends and feature-call.mjs (its own row) are unledgered.
